cases.idea: Mira finds Grandma's anklet near the village well and returns it to Grandma before sunset. Do not add a reward.

scenes.narration: మనమరాలు మీరా, తన అమ్మమ్మ కాలి పట్టీని ఊరి బావి దగ్గర గడ్డిలో పడి ఉండటం గమనించింది.
scenes.visual: A young girl named Mira wearing a blue Pochampally cotton dress looking down at an intricate silver anklet lying on the dry red soil near a stone village well.

scenes.narration: అది అమ్మమ్మ పట్టీయే అని గుర్తుపట్టి, మీరా ఆ వెండి పట్టీని జాగ్రత్తగా తన చేతిలోకి తీసుకుంది.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Mira picking up the shiny silver anklet from the ground, recognizing it as she holds it in her palm.

scenes.narration: సూర్యుడు అస్తమించకముందే అమ్మమ్మకు ఆ పట్టీని అందించాలని మీరా ఇంటి వైపు వేగంగా నడిచింది.
scenes.visual: Mira walking briskly along a narrow village path lined with Deccan granite boulders, with the sun still visible in the sky.

scenes.narration: సూర్యాస్తమయం కావడానికి ముందే మీరా అమ్మమ్మకు ఆ వెండి పట్టీని తిరిగి ఇచ్చేసింది.
scenes.visual: Mira handing the silver anklet to her elderly Grandma, who is sitting on a neem-tree wooden stool in her courtyard, while the sun is setting in the background.

cases.idea: Two sisters find a lost school bag at the bus stop and return it unopened to its owner before the bus leaves. Do not invent a cash reward.

scenes.narration: बस स्टैंड की भीड़ में, दो बहनें मीरा और पूजा को अचानक ये नीला बस्ता पड़ा हुआ मिला।
scenes.visual: Meera and Pooja, two sisters in colorful Rajasthani kurtas, standing at a dusty village bus stop, looking down at a worn-out blue school bag lying on the ground.

scenes.narration: उन्होंने अपनी ईमानदारी बनाए रखी और उस नीले बस्ते को बिना खोले बस के पास खड़े एक छात्र की तलाश की।
scenes.visual: Meera and Pooja standing side by side, keeping their hands away from the blue school bag, looking around the bus stop area for the owner.

scenes.narration: बस के रवाना होने से ठीक पहले, उन्होंने भागकर वह नीला बस्ता अपने पास खड़े सहपाठी को थमा दिया।
scenes.visual: Meera and Pooja handing the blue school bag directly to a schoolboy standing near the bus door just as the engine starts.

scenes.narration: सही मालिक तक बस्ता पहुँचाकर बहनों के चेहरे पर संतोष की मुस्कान आ गई।
scenes.visual: The bus pulling away into the distance; the schoolboy looking back from the window with the blue school bag, while Meera and Pooja smile at each other.
